Circumflex Accent Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Circumflex Accent is 94. Hold Alt, type 94 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Circumflex Accent also has the Unicode codepoint U+005E, so you can type it with Alt+94 on Windows, search for U+005E in macOS's Character Viewer, use ^ in HTML, or \005E in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. Copy the Circumflex Accent character from this page when you need it in a form, chat message or document that does not accept Alt codes. Circumflex Accent has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape ^ or the hex escape ^.

How to type circumflex accent on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 9 4 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Circumflex Accent character (^) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type circumflex accent on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Circumflex Accent. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Circumflex Accent" and click the character to insert it.

How to use circumflex accent in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\005E"; ()
  • Python: \u005E or chr(0x5E)
  • JavaScript: \u005E or String.fromCodePoint(0x5E)
  • JSON: "\u005E"

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Circumflex Accent?

The legacy Alt code for Circumflex Accent is 94. Hold Alt, type 9 4 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type ^ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ^, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+94 not work?

Alt+94 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Circumflex Accent?

The Unicode codepoint for Circumflex Accent is U+005E. You can use this value in HTML as ^, in CSS as \005E, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ^ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+005E, then click it.
